state_schema.missing_data_policy: fail if source domain, target domain, or transfer split is absent

dynamics.update_law: train on frozen source domain, score untouched target domain
dynamics.time_axis: not applicable; cross-domain transfer protocol only

boundary_conditions: only HAOS structural descriptors are allowed into the transfer model
symmetries: source and target splits frozen before evaluation
same scoring path for target and controls

haos_mapping.mapping_function: transfer structural descriptors without domain-specific tuning
haos_mapping.semantic_justification: tests whether recoverability is transferable across domains
haos_mapping.uncertainty: must be measured on untouched target domain
failure_conditions: domain-specific features leak into the transfer model

observation_map.measurement_rule: rank recoverability on the target domain from frozen source-domain descriptors
target-domain recovery ranking under frozen transfer protocol

prediction_target: is recoverability a transferable structural property across domains?
calibration_split: source-domain development and calibration frozen before target evaluation

controls.name: label_permutation
controls.invalid_if: permuted labels preserve the same transfer gain

controls.name: domain_swap_null
controls.purpose: ensure transfer is not a domain shortcut
controls.invalid_if: null transfer matches the intended transfer score

controls.name: topology_destroyed
controls.purpose: remove transferable structure from the source descriptors

controls.name: seed_repeat
controls.invalid_if: same seed changes the transfer verdict

baselines.name: supervised_transfer_baseline
baselines.prediction_rule: train on source domain, evaluate untouched target domain

uncertainty: report confidence intervals, seed variance, and holdout degradation

invalidation_conditions: source or target domain changes after freeze
falsification.underpowered_policy: report UNDERPOWERED when sample-size gate is not met
falsification.leakage_policy: no target-domain leakage into feature design or thresholding

verdict_logic: Most likely negative; only a frozen transfer improvement on untouched target domains is a candidate success.
